title: Centered deterministic BSGS with exact inverse-orbit keys and charged routing

claims.statement: For every valid full-production supplied-P fixed-G1 pairing-inversion instance, the centered deterministic BSGS algorithm in proof.md returns Q in G2 with pairing(Q,P)=z. Success is 1. Total cold work, including all preprocessing, routing, complete-key sorting/lookup, arithmetic, reconstruction and verification, is at most 2^142 reference equivalents under C=20000. Peak memory is <=2^145 bytes, preprocessing <=2^142 equivalents included in total, and nonuniform advice is zero bytes. The explicit finite distributed-storage/message model is a material assumption, not a physical production implementation claim.
